# Mapping disproportionate levels of lead paint risk in Philadelphia County
As a

## Load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(stars)
```

## Import data
```{r}
# Read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 
```

```{r}
# Filter to Pennsylvania
pennsylvania <- ejscreen |> 
    dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "PA") 

# Filter to Philadelphia County
philadelphia <- ejscreen |> 
    dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Philadelphia County"))
```

## Visualize Data
```{r}
# Plot percent people of color at census block level
pct_ppl_color <- tm_shape(philadelphia['Shape']) +
    tm_borders() + 
tm_shape(philadelphia['PEOPCOLORPCT']) +
    tm_polygons(
        fill = 'PEOPCOLORPCT',
        fill.scale = tm_scale(values = 'Orange'),
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Percent people of color")) +
tm_title("Percent people of color at census block level in Philadelphia County") +
tm_compass() +
tm_scalebar()
```

```{r}
# Plot percent housing units built before 1960 (lead risk)
pct_pb_pnt <- tm_shape(philadelphia['Shape']) +
    tm_borders() + 
tm_shape(philadelphia['P_LDPNT']) +
    tm_polygons(
        fill = 'P_LDPNT',
        fill.scale = tm_scale(values = 'Orange'),
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Percent housing units built before 1960 in Philadelphia"),
        ) +
tm_compass() +
tm_scalebar()
```

```{r}
# Display maps side by side
tmap_arrange(pct_ppl_color, pct_pb_pnt, ncol = 2)
```
